name: Kogure Shinpei
source:
The manager of the family restaurant where Ayumu works part-time.

He is a kind manager who cares deeply about his staff and warmly watches over the developing romance between Ayumu and Kensuke.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
